simplegadgets.guide.page.1.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.2.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.2: the Gauge - a speed dial, an altimeter that warns of fall damage and auto-walk along paths and rails -
simplegadgets.guide.page.3.title: Simple Gadgets
simplegadgets.guide.page.3: the Transposer, which turns and swaps blocks in place, and the Resonance Rod, a beam that points, melts, ignites and measures.
simplegadgets.guide.page.4.title: Gauge
simplegadgets.guide.page.4: The Gauge shows speed while held in either hand, with an animated item needle and a HUD dial.
simplegadgets.guide.page.5.title: Transposer
simplegadgets.guide.page.5: The Transposer is a handy tool for turning orientable blocks right where they are in the world, without breaking and replacing them.
simplegadgets.guide.page.6.title: Transposer
simplegadgets.guide.page.6: It helps above all when building with logs and pillars, with furnaces, pistons or hoppers, and with every block that turns in 16 steps. Where you click on a block face decides how it turns. It never breaks:
simplegadgets.guide.page.7.title: Transposer
simplegadgets.guide.page.7: its durability is a charge that you top up at the anvil with ender pearls.
simplegadgets.guide.page.8.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.8: A held Gauge shows its readout in a small dark box next to the crosshair: the item's name as the title, a speed dial with the number in blocks per second, and further lines.
simplegadgets.guide.page.9.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.9: With SimpleBuilding the box stacks with the Octant's and the Resonance Rod's boxes (Octant on top, then Gauge, then Rod) and
simplegadgets.guide.page.10.title: Readout box
simplegadgets.guide.page.10: follows SimpleBuilding's HUD position, size and HUD key; alone it sits at the left edge in the middle of the screen.
simplegadgets.guide.page.11.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplegadgets.guide.page.11: The Gauge, the Transposer and the Resonance Rod, their recipes and recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simplegadgets.guide.page.12.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplegadgets.guide.page.12: Old worlds load them under simplegadgets:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids - in inventories, chests and on the ground alike.
simplegadgets.guide.page.13.title: Creative tabs
simplegadgets.guide.page.13: Own tab with the gadgets and the guide. Without SimpleBuilding the gadgets also sit behind the recovery compass in the Vanilla tools tab (switch addItemsToVanillaTabs); with SimpleBuilding its tabs list them in their old places.
simplegadgets.guide.page.14.title: Creative tabs
simplegadgets.guide.page.14: Switched off (SimpleBuilding's Enable Simple Gadgets), the tab and the Vanilla tab entries are empty; the gadgets keep working.
